story_type: fighter jet stopped by a runway arresting cable
hook: This F-16 has to catch a steel cable at full speed.
narration: This F-16 is racing down the runway to snag a steel cable with its tailhook.
In an emergency landing, a cable like this is what slows the jet down.
The cable runs to big brake drums beside the runway, which pay it out and soak up the jet's speed.
It was the first successful test since the inner runways reopened in October.
Then crews hauled the cable back into place for the next jet.
outcome: The F-16s hooked the cable, and the barrier passed its first successful certification.
title: F-16 snags a runway cable at speed
description:
Airmen certify a runway aircraft arresting system with F-16 Fighting Falcons at an undisclosed location in the U.S. Central Command area of responsibility, Nov. 18, 2023.
